name: Recitation Drills for Craft Rules
prompt:
Create ONE Tomorrow and Tomorrow research painting. Reference controls ONLY established knowledge medium/palette and exact EXTRA-WIDE WIDTH/aspect. Lapis/parchment crosshatched blue-black ink; clear storytelling through listening and repeated gestures, no written text/tablets/school building.
